title: Boot / orientation substrate
settles: A stable CORE-centred orientation surface from which selection is possible

steps.name: app opens through the contract port
CORE persists as a single rendered anchor
VAR-001 quiet world stays sparse while data is hidden
no heavy artifact renderer is loaded
VAR-002 waking surfaces the consequential object among routine ones
composer and chrome are available; work objects are selectable

title: Focus substrate
settles: Focus is a reusable primitive that preserves CORE as orientation and object identity

steps.name: select a work object and fly into it
CORE remains the home anchor and is not recreated
local relationships and details are exposed
unfocus returns through the hierarchy to Home
focus again: identity and state survive
the Core anchor returns Home

title: Artifact inspection substrate
settles: Artifacts disclose progressively (pill → excerpt → viewer) without destroying spatial context

steps.name: a source-backed preview is disclosed from its object
selecting it opens the right-side viewer with the diff renderer
interact: search highlights, a line can be selected
source and provenance are preserved
a second artifact kind on the same object (tab)
close returns to the exact prior context
reopen, pin (local), close: the pinned artifact stays available

title: Representation-switching substrate
settles: Orbital, causal and comparison are projections of the same objects (identity, selection and state carry across)

steps.name: mark the source objects' rendered identity
orbital → causal: the same objects re-arrange
select in the causal representation
causal → orbital: the selection is the same object
orbital → comparison of the same objects
return without duplicate state

title: Temporal + comparison substrate
settles: Time/version and comparison are trustworthy operators that never mutate source history

steps.name: enter historical inspection
VAR-004 traverse three historical positions
the past is the same objects at an earlier state (read-only)
mark two positions and compare them
inspect a source artifact during comparison
exit comparison back to the single historical position
return to live
no source-history mutation

title: Narrated semantic-beat journey
settles: Narration composes focus, arrangement, artifacts and time through the same grammar, and is interruptible

steps.name: ask a contextual question; a multi-beat explanation starts
a beat reveals source evidence; the user interrupts by inspecting it
dismiss and return to the explanation's world
resume continues from the checkpoint and finishes
VAR-005 two artifact kinds, source evidence preserved
RECOV-003 lose the agent adapter mid-explanation; direct UI stays usable

title: Causal reasoning journey
settles: The causal projection is a working thinking representation with inspectable evidence

steps.name: enter the causal representation
expected, missing condition and observed are distinct, with causal links
select a causal node
inspect the supporting source (expected vs observed)
move between causal and orbital without identity loss
return to the prior focus

title: Case Design journey
settles: Case Design is a bounded thinking/proposal environment that never mutates authoritative state

steps.name: enter Case Design from the focused case
inspect structure: select a design node
inspect an earlier published version
propose: reorder a stage and change required evidence (local draft)
save the draft locally; submission is honestly unavailable
compare the proposal with the published structure
authoritative template unchanged by the proposal
leave Case Design back to the case, without mutation

title: Consequential-action UI journey (contract adapter)
settles: Human and agent consequences share one intent path; authority, execution, evidence and settlement are distinct

steps.name: a consequential action opens judgment (backend-offered choices)
VAR-007 agent attempts the same consequence through the same path → denied
a justification-required choice is validated before sending
the human approves on a fresh attempt → accepted
execution is visible and completion does not read as settlement
evidence appears and settlement is authoritative
inspect execution, evidence and settlement
the world reorganises from the settled projection

title: Integrated cognitive-environment journey (contract adapter)
settles: The full reference path works end to end on settled primitives, with no deep links

steps.name: orientation → focus
progressively resolve representation (semantic zoom)
inspect and dismiss a source artifact
contextual question → interruptible narrated answer
temporal rewind, compare two positions, return to live
causal representation and case design
consequential action: agent denied, human accepted (fresh attempts)
execution → evidence → authoritative settlement
world reorganised by the settled projection; return and orient at CORE

title: UI-level recovery (bounded failures)
settles: Failures stay bounded; authoritative frontend state and the persistent Core survive

steps.name: RECOV-004 optional renderer fails: isolated, source reference kept
invalid payload: bounded error, no collapse
unavailable source: bounded error
leave temporal/comparison mid-state and return
interrupt a transition mid-flight
resize during focused, artifact and temporal states
repeated open/close of the viewer leaks no state
navigation never recreated the persistent Core
